statement: I was driving through a built up area with a number of traffic lights. Traffic was very dense and slow moving.  I heard a siren and many cars started moving out of the way of an ambulance and police car travelling in the road behind me. I was positioned just before the junction at a green light, but unable to enter the junction as there was traffic on the other side. The junction was narrow with a pedestrian island in the middle, so there was no room to manouver. As the two emergency vehicles approached, with cars moving to the left and right, I was hoping for the traffic on the other side to clear so that I could move on and clear the junction. As they came behind me, the lights cycled to red. I could see the police car driver in my mirror, and they seemed to be motioning for me to clear the way immediately, waving their hand emphatically. I moved just past the white line to allow both emergency vehicles to pass, when the lights changed to green again, so I moved forward to continue my journey. A week or so later I received a letter in the post advising me that I had committed an offence and would have a fine and 3 penalty points. I have tried to speak to people about it but they tell me that it's an offence even if I moved to let the ambulance through. These extra points will make my car insurance so expensive, I am worried I will need to get rid of my car.
